candidates.summary: Open the fourth Saturday in May through October 15, on the segment from Highway 65 to the South Sutter Irrigation District Diversion Dam.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: Applies only to hatchery (adipose-fin-clipped) trout or steelhead; combined daily bag of 2, combined possession limit of 4, on the Highway 65 to South Sutter ID Diversion Dam segment.

candidates.summary: 2 hatchery trout or hatchery steelhead daily bag; 4 in possession, on the Highway 65 to South Sutter ID Diversion Dam segment.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Only hatchery trout or steelhead showing a healed adipose fin clip may be retained; wild (unclipped) trout or steelhead must be released immediately.

candidates.summary: Wild (unclipped) trout and steelhead must be released immediately; only adipose-fin-clipped hatchery fish count toward the bag, on the Highway 65 to South Sutter ID Diversion Dam segment.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
